title: App settings
brief: App settings opened from the rail's Settings button: theme (dark, light, system), interface font size, and the MCP policy of config.toml (read, write, execute, destructive as Allow, Ask or Deny; hosts; environments; per-workspace overrides), the config file path, and the state where config.toml does not parse. Built on the bolt-v2 shell, DBFlux's settings window and design/variables/01-settings-page.html. Each artboard stacks its states as 900 px frames.

artboards.title: Settings window
artboards.tradeoff: Same shape as DBFlux's settings window (search, section nav, Revert and Save footer) and editable per-workspace overrides on their own page; a modal over the app, and a third settings surface beside the workspace page

artboards.title: Workspace settings page with an App section
artboards.tradeoff: One settings place: the built workspace page gains App > General and App > MCP policy, writes at once like variables; overrides are read-only there (edit config.toml by hand), and app and workspace settings share one nav

artboards.title: Policy matrix tab
artboards.tradeoff: Settings as a document tab: global, per-workspace and effective policy side by side with a config.toml diff before Save; dense, grows wide past three or four overrides, and needs a grid cell with an inline dropdown that bolt lacks
